export async function deleteCommitsByBranch(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
  branch: string,
): Promise<number> {
  const result = await db
    .deleteFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits")
    .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
    .where("branch", "=", branch)
    .executeTakeFirst();

  return Number(result.numDeletedRows);
}

// Delete stale commits for a branch that are not in the valid set of checkpoint IDs.
// Used during sync backfill to reconcile after force pushes or history rewrites.
export async function deleteStaleCommitsForBranch(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
  branch: string,
  validCheckpointIds: string[],
): Promise<number> {
  if (validCheckpointIds.length === 0) {
    // No valid checkpoints = delete all commits for this branch
    return deleteCommitsByBranch(db, repoId, branch);
  }

  const result = await db
    .deleteFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits")
    .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
    .where("branch", "=", branch)
    .where("checkpoint_id", "not in", validCheckpointIds)
    .executeTakeFirst();

  return Number(result.numDeletedRows);
}

export async function deleteOrphanedCheckpoints(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
): Promise<number> {
  // Get all checkpoint_ids that have commits
  const commitsData = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits")
    .select("checkpoint_id")
    .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
    .execute();

  const commitCheckpointIds = new Set(commitsData.map((c) => c.checkpoint_id));

  // Get all checkpoints for this repo
  const checkpointsData = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoints")
    .select(["id", "checkpoint_id", "created_at"])
    .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
    .execute();

  // Grace period: don't delete checkpoints created in the last 5 minutes
  const gracePeriodMs = 5 * 60 * 1000;
  const cutoffTime = Date.now() - gracePeriodMs;

  const orphanedIds = checkpointsData
    .filter((cp) => {
      if (commitCheckpointIds.has(cp.checkpoint_id)) return false;
      if (!cp.created_at) return true;
      return cp.created_at.getTime() < cutoffTime;
    })
    .map((cp) => cp.id);

  if (orphanedIds.length === 0) return 0;

  // Delete orphaned checkpoints in batches to avoid oversized IN lists.
  // Each batch re-checks via NOT IN subquery to avoid FK violations from race conditions.
  const BATCH_SIZE = 100;
  let totalDeleted = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < orphanedIds.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
    const batch = orphanedIds.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);
    const result = await db
      .deleteFrom("repo_checkpoints")
      .where("id", "in", batch)
      .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
      .where((eb) =>
        eb(
          "checkpoint_id",
          "not in",
          eb
            .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits")
            .select("checkpoint_id")
            .where("repo_id", "=", repoId),
        ),
      )
      .executeTakeFirst();

    totalDeleted += Number(result.numDeletedRows);
  }

  return totalDeleted;
}

export async function recalculateCheckpointCount(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
): Promise<void> {
  // Count distinct checkpoints that have commits
  const rows = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits")
    .select("checkpoint_id")
    .distinct()
    .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
    .execute();

  // CRITICAL: If query fails it will throw, which is safe (won't set to 0)
  await db
    .updateTable("repos")
    .set({
      checkpoint_count: rows.length,
      updated_at: new Date(),
    })
    .where("id", "=", repoId)
    .execute();
}

/**
 * Returns the week index (0-51) for a commit date relative to currentWeekStart.
 * Week 51 = current week, week 0 = 51 weeks ago. Returns null if outside the 52-week window.
 * Week boundaries align to Sunday 00:00:00.
 */
export function commitDateToWeekIndex(commitDate: Date, currentWeekStart: Date): number | null {
  const weeksAgo = Math.ceil(
    (currentWeekStart.getTime() - commitDate.getTime()) / (7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
  );

  if (weeksAgo >= 0 && weeksAgo < 52) {
    return 51 - weeksAgo;
  }
  return null;
}

export async function getCheckpointActivityForUser(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  userId: string,
): Promise<RepoCommitActivity[]> {
  const fiftyTwoWeeksAgo = new Date();
  fiftyTwoWeeksAgo.setDate(fiftyTwoWeeksAgo.getDate() - 52 * 7);

  const commits = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits as cc")
    .innerJoin("repos", "repos.id", "cc.repo_id")
    .innerJoin("user_repos", (join) =>
      join
        .onRef("user_repos.repo_id", "=", "repos.id")
        .on("user_repos.user_id", "=", userId),
    )
    .select([
      "cc.repo_id",
      "cc.checkpoint_id",
      "cc.commit_date",
      "repos.full_name",
    ])
    .where("repos.is_fork", "=", 0)
    .where("cc.commit_date", ">=", fiftyTwoWeeksAgo)
    .where("cc.commit_date", "is not", null)
    .execute();

  // Build repo map
  const repoMap = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const commit of commits) {
    if (commit.repo_id && !repoMap.has(commit.repo_id)) {
      repoMap.set(commit.repo_id, commit.full_name);
    }
  }

  // Calculate the start of the current week (Sunday)
  const now = new Date();
  const currentWeekStart = new Date(now);
  currentWeekStart.setDate(now.getDate() - now.getDay());
  currentWeekStart.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

  const oldestWeekStart = new Date(currentWeekStart);
  oldestWeekStart.setDate(oldestWeekStart.getDate() - 51 * 7);
  const weekStartTimestamp = Math.floor(oldestWeekStart.getTime() / 1000);

  // Aggregate commits by repo and week, deduplicating by checkpoint_id
  const repoWeeks = new Map<string, number[]>();
  const seenCheckpoints = new Map<string, Set<string>>();

  for (const commit of commits) {
    const repoFullName = repoMap.get(commit.repo_id ?? "");
    if (!repoFullName || !commit.commit_date) continue;

    const commitDate = commit.commit_date instanceof Date
      ? commit.commit_date
      : new Date(commit.commit_date);
    const weekIndex = commitDateToWeekIndex(commitDate, currentWeekStart);

    if (weekIndex !== null) {
      const dedupeKey = `${repoFullName}:${weekIndex}`;

      if (!seenCheckpoints.has(dedupeKey)) {
        seenCheckpoints.set(dedupeKey, new Set());
      }
      const seen = seenCheckpoints.get(dedupeKey)!;
      if (seen.has(commit.checkpoint_id)) continue;
      seen.add(commit.checkpoint_id);

      if (!repoWeeks.has(repoFullName)) {
        repoWeeks.set(repoFullName, new Array(52).fill(0));
      }
      repoWeeks.get(repoFullName)![weekIndex]++;
    }
  }

  const activities: RepoCommitActivity[] = [];
  for (const [repoFullName, weeks] of repoWeeks) {
    activities.push({ repo_full_name: repoFullName, weeks, week_start: weekStartTimestamp });
  }

  return activities;
}

export async function getCheckpointsByUser(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  userId: string,
  githubId: number,
  startDate: string,
  endDate: string,
  limit: number = 500,
): Promise<UserCheckpoint[]> {
  const commits = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits as cc")
    .innerJoin("repos", "repos.id", "cc.repo_id")
    .innerJoin("user_repos", (join) =>
      join
        .onRef("user_repos.repo_id", "=", "repos.id")
        .on("user_repos.user_id", "=", userId),
    )
    .leftJoin("repo_checkpoints as cp", (join) =>
      join
        .onRef("cp.repo_id", "=", "cc.repo_id")
        .onRef("cp.checkpoint_id", "=", "cc.checkpoint_id"),
    )
    .select([
      "cc.checkpoint_id",
      "cc.branch",
      "cc.commit_sha",
      "cc.commit_message",
      "cc.commit_date",
      "cc.additions",
      "cc.deletions",
      "cc.files_changed",
      "cc.repo_id",
      "repos.full_name as repo_full_name",
      "repos.is_private",
      "cp.agent",
      "cp.steps",
      "cp.session_count",
      "cp.input_tokens",
      "cp.output_tokens",
    ])
    .where("cc.commit_author_github_id", "=", githubId)
    .where("cc.commit_date", ">=", new Date(startDate))
    .where("cc.commit_date", "<=", new Date(endDate))
    .orderBy("cc.commit_date", "desc")
    .limit(limit * 2) // Fetch extra to account for duplicates
    .execute();

  if (commits.length === 0) return [];

  // Deduplicate by (repo_id, checkpoint_id), preferring main branch
  const deduplicatedCommits = new Map<string, (typeof commits)[0]>();

  for (const commit of commits) {
    const key = `${commit.repo_id}:${commit.checkpoint_id}`;
    const existing = deduplicatedCommits.get(key);

    if (!existing) {
      deduplicatedCommits.set(key, commit);
    } else if (commit.branch === "main" && existing.branch !== "main") {
      deduplicatedCommits.set(key, commit);
    }
  }

  return Array.from(deduplicatedCommits.values())
    .slice(0, limit)
    .map((commit) => ({
      checkpoint_id: commit.checkpoint_id,
      commit_sha: commit.commit_sha,
      commit_message: commit.commit_message,
      commit_date: dateToStr(commit.commit_date),
      additions: commit.additions ?? 0,
      deletions: commit.deletions ?? 0,
      files_changed: commit.files_changed ?? 0,
      repo_full_name: commit.repo_full_name ?? "",
      branch: commit.branch,
      is_private: toBool(commit.is_private),
      agent: commit.agent ?? null,
      steps: commit.steps ?? null,
      session_count: commit.session_count ?? null,
      input_tokens: commit.input_tokens ?? null,
      output_tokens: commit.output_tokens ?? null,
    }));
}

    .where("checkpoint_id", "in", checkpointIds);

  if (branch) {
    query = query.where("branch", "=", branch);
  }

  const rows = await query.execute();
  return new Set(rows.map((r) => r.checkpoint_id));
}

export async function upsertSyncCheckpointBatch(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
  checkpoints: CheckpointData[],
): Promise<number> {
  if (checkpoints.length === 0) return 0;

  const uniqueCheckpoints = deduplicateCheckpoints(checkpoints);
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  let successCount = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < uniqueCheckpoints.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
    const batch = uniqueCheckpoints.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);

    // Fetch existing records for COALESCE behavior
    let existingRecords;
    try {
      existingRecords = await db
        .selectFrom("repo_checkpoints")
        .selectAll()
        .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
        .where("checkpoint_id", "in", batch.map((cp) => cp.checkpoint_id))
        .execute();
    } catch (e) {
      syncLog("fetch_existing_checkpoints_error", { batch: i / BATCH_SIZE + 1, error: String(e) });
      continue;
    }

    const existingMap = new Map(existingRecords.map((row) => [row.checkpoint_id, row]));

    const safeJsonParse = (value: string | null | undefined, fallback: unknown): unknown => {
      if (!value) return fallback;
      try {
        return JSON.parse(value);
      } catch {
        syncLog("json_parse_error", { value: value.substring(0, 100) });
        return fallback;
      }
    };

    for (const cp of batch) {
      const existing = existingMap.get(cp.checkpoint_id);
      const values = {
        id: existing?.id ?? generateId(),
        repo_id: repoId,
        checkpoint_id: cp.checkpoint_id,
        prompt: cp.prompt ?? existing?.prompt ?? null,
        agent: cp.agent ?? existing?.agent ?? "Claude Code",
        steps: cp.steps ?? existing?.steps ?? 1,
        session_count: cp.session_count ?? existing?.session_count ?? 1,
        strategy: cp.strategy ?? existing?.strategy ?? null,
        branch: cp.branch ?? existing?.branch ?? null,
        session_id: cp.session_id ?? existing?.session_id ?? null,
        files_touched: JSON.stringify(safeJsonParse(cp.files_touched, existing?.files_touched ?? null)) as unknown as string,
        session_ids: JSON.stringify(safeJsonParse(cp.session_ids, existing?.session_ids ?? null)) as unknown as string,
        transcript_uuid_at_start: cp.transcript_uuid_at_start ?? existing?.transcript_uuid_at_start ?? null,
        transcript_lines_at_start: cp.transcript_lines_at_start ?? existing?.transcript_lines_at_start ?? null,
        checkpoint_transcript_start:
          cp.checkpoint_transcript_start ??
          existing?.checkpoint_transcript_start ??
          cp.transcript_lines_at_start ??
          existing?.transcript_lines_at_start ??
          null,
        input_tokens: cp.input_tokens ?? existing?.input_tokens ?? null,
        cache_creation_tokens: cp.cache_creation_tokens ?? existing?.cache_creation_tokens ?? null,
        cache_read_tokens: cp.cache_read_tokens ?? existing?.cache_read_tokens ?? null,
        output_tokens: cp.output_tokens ?? existing?.output_tokens ?? null,
        api_call_count: cp.api_call_count ?? existing?.api_call_count ?? null,
        sessions: JSON.stringify(safeJsonParse(cp.sessions, existing?.sessions ?? null)) as unknown as string,
        created_at: cp.created_at ? new Date(cp.created_at) : existing?.created_at ?? new Date(now),
        synced_at: new Date(now),
      };

      try {
        await db
          .insertInto("repo_checkpoints")
          .values(values)
          .onDuplicateKeyUpdate({
            prompt: values.prompt,
            agent: values.agent,
            steps: values.steps,
            session_count: values.session_count,
            strategy: values.strategy,
            branch: values.branch,
            session_id: values.session_id,
            files_touched: values.files_touched,
            session_ids: values.session_ids,
            transcript_uuid_at_start: values.transcript_uuid_at_start,
            transcript_lines_at_start: values.transcript_lines_at_start,
            checkpoint_transcript_start: values.checkpoint_transcript_start,
            input_tokens: values.input_tokens,
            cache_creation_tokens: values.cache_creation_tokens,
            cache_read_tokens: values.cache_read_tokens,
            output_tokens: values.output_tokens,
            api_call_count: values.api_call_count,
            sessions: values.sessions,
            created_at: values.created_at,
            synced_at: values.synced_at,
          })
          .execute();
        successCount++;
      } catch (e) {
        syncLog("upsert_checkpoint_error", { checkpoint_id: cp.checkpoint_id, error: String(e) });
        continue;
      }
    }
  }

  return successCount;
}

export async function upsertSyncCommitBatch(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
  commits: CommitData[],
): Promise<number> {
  if (commits.length === 0) return 0;

  const uniqueCommits = deduplicateCommits(commits);
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  let successCount = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < uniqueCommits.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
    const batch = uniqueCommits.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);

    let existingRecords;
    try {
      existingRecords = await db
        .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits")
        .selectAll()
        .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
        .where("checkpoint_id", "in", batch.map((c) => c.checkpoint_id))

    } catch (e) {

      continue;
    }

    const existingMap = new Map(existingRecords.map((row) => [`${row.checkpoint_id}:${row.branch}`, row]));

    for (const c of batch) {

      const values = {

        repo_id: repoId,

        synced_at: new Date(now),
      };

      try {
        await db
          .insertInto("repo_checkpoint_commits")
          .values(values)
          .onDuplicateKeyUpdate({
            commit_sha: values.commit_sha,
            commit_message: values.commit_message,
            commit_author: values.commit_author,
            commit_author_username: values.commit_author_username,
            commit_author_github_id: values.commit_author_github_id,
            commit_date: values.commit_date,

          })
          .execute();
        successCount++;
      } catch (e) {

      }
    }
  }

  return successCount;

export async function updateRepoSyncState(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
  options: {
    cursor?: string;
    backfilled?: boolean;
    resetBackfill?: boolean;
    error?: string;
  },
): Promise<void> {
  const now = new Date();

  if (options.error) {
    await db
      .updateTable("repos")
      .set({
        checkpoints_sync_error: options.error,
        checkpoints_sync_error_at: now,
        updated_at: now,
      })
      .where("id", "=", repoId)
      .execute();
    return;
  }

  const updates: Record<string, unknown> = {
    checkpoints_last_synced_at: now,
    checkpoints_sync_error: null,
    checkpoints_sync_error_at: null,
    updated_at: now,
  };

  if (options.cursor) {
    updates.checkpoints_sync_cursor = options.cursor;
  }

  if (options.backfilled) {
    updates.checkpoints_backfilled_at = now;
  }

  // Force a full re-backfill on the next sync (e.g., after force push)
  if (options.resetBackfill) {
    updates.checkpoints_backfilled_at = null;
    updates.checkpoints_sync_cursor = null;
  }

  await db
    .updateTable("repos")
    .set(updates)
    .where("id", "=", repoId)
    .execute();
}

export function createCheckpointsNamespace(db: Kysely<DB>): CheckpointsNamespace {
  return {
    // Query
    getForBranch: (repoId, branch, options) => getCheckpointsForBranch(db, repoId, branch, options),
    countForBranch: async (repoId, branch) => {
      const result = await db
        .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits")
        .select(db.fn.countAll().as("count"))
        .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
        .where("branch", "=", branch)
        .executeTakeFirstOrThrow();
      return Number(result.count);
    },
    getRepoWithCheckpoints: (repoFullName, userId, branch, limit) => getRepoWithCheckpoints(db, repoFullName, userId, branch, limit),
    getBranchesWithCheckpoints: (repoId) => getBranchesWithCheckpoints(db, repoId),
    branchHasCommits: (repoId, branch) => branchHasCheckpointCommits(db, repoId, branch),
    findById: (repoId, checkpointId, defaultBranch) => findCheckpointById(db, repoId, checkpointId, defaultBranch),
    getByIds: (repoId, checkpointIds) => getCheckpointsByIds(db, repoId, checkpointIds),
    getActivityForUser: (userId) => getCheckpointActivityForUser(db, userId),
    getByUser: (userId, githubId, startDate, endDate, limit) => getCheckpointsByUser(db, userId, githubId, startDate, endDate, limit),
    // Mutations
    upsertBatch: (repoId, checkpoints) => upsertCheckpointBatch(db, repoId, checkpoints),
    upsertCommitBatch: (repoId, branch, commits) => upsertCheckpointCommitBatch(db, repoId, branch, commits),
    deleteCommitsByBranch: (repoId, branch) => deleteCommitsByBranch(db, repoId, branch),
    deleteOrphaned: (repoId) => deleteOrphanedCheckpoints(db, repoId),
    deleteStaleCommitsForBranch: (repoId, branch, validCheckpointIds) => deleteStaleCommitsForBranch(db, repoId, branch, validCheckpointIds),
    recalculateCount: (repoId) => recalculateCheckpointCount(db, repoId),
    // Sync
    getIdsWithCommits: (repoId, checkpointIds, branch) => getCheckpointIdsWithCommitsForRepo(db, repoId, checkpointIds, branch),
    upsertSyncCheckpointBatch: (repoId, checkpoints) => upsertSyncCheckpointBatch(db, repoId, checkpoints),
    upsertSyncCommitBatch: (repoId, commits) => upsertSyncCommitBatch(db, repoId, commits),
    updateSyncState: (repoId, options) => updateRepoSyncState(db, repoId, options),
  };
}

// Kysely database helpers for checkpoint operations (MySQL/PlanetScale)

import type { Kysely } from "kysely";
import type { DB, Json } from "../../../db/types";
import { deduplicateCheckpoints, deduplicateCommits } from "../db/sync-types";
import { generateId } from "../uuid";
import type { CheckpointData, CommitData } from "../db/sync-types";
import type {
  FileStats,
  CheckpointWithCommit,
  RepoWithCheckpointsResult,
  CheckpointLocation,
  CheckpointWebhookData,
  CommitWebhookData,
  UserCheckpoint,
  RepoCommitActivity,
} from "../db/checkpoints";
import type { CheckpointsNamespace } from "../db/db-types";
import type { Repo } from "../db/repos";
import { dateToStr, toBool } from "./row-helpers";

const LOG_PREFIX = "[db-checkpoints]";

// --- Checkpoint Functions ---

export async function getCheckpointsForBranch(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
  branch: string,
  options: { limit?: number } = {},
): Promise<CheckpointWithCommit[]> {
  const { limit = 100 } = options;

  // Deferred join: sort/limit on IDs only to avoid "Out of sort memory" on large JSON columns.
  // PlanetScale's sort buffer can't hold file_stats blobs for many rows during ORDER BY.
  const idRows = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits")
    .select("id")
    .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
    .where("branch", "=", branch)
    .orderBy("commit_date", "desc")
    .limit(limit)
    .execute();

  if (idRows.length === 0) return [];

  const rows = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits as cc")
    .leftJoin("repo_checkpoints as cp", (join) =>
      join
        .onRef("cp.repo_id", "=", "cc.repo_id")
        .onRef("cp.checkpoint_id", "=", "cc.checkpoint_id"),
    )
    .select([
      "cc.id",
      "cc.checkpoint_id",
      "cc.branch",
      "cc.commit_sha",
      "cc.commit_message",
      "cc.commit_author",
      "cc.commit_author_username",
      "cc.commit_date",
      "cc.additions",
      "cc.deletions",
      "cc.files_changed",
      "cc.file_stats",
      "cp.prompt",
      "cp.agent",
      "cp.steps",
      "cp.session_count",
      "cp.strategy",
      "cp.created_at",
      "cp.files_touched",
      "cp.input_tokens",
      "cp.cache_creation_tokens",
      "cp.cache_read_tokens",
      "cp.output_tokens",
      "cp.api_call_count",
      "cp.attribution_agent_lines",
      "cp.attribution_human_added",
      "cp.attribution_human_modified",
      "cp.attribution_human_removed",
      "cp.attribution_total_committed",
      "cp.attribution_agent_percentage",
      "cp.attribution_calculated_at",
    ])
    .where(
      "cc.id",
      "in",
      idRows.map((r) => r.id),
    )
    .execute();

  // Restore sort order from the first query (already sorted by commit_date desc)
  // without ORDER BY on the large-row query which causes OOM on the sort buffer.
  const rowById = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.id, r]));
  const sorted = idRows.map((r) => rowById.get(r.id)).filter(Boolean) as typeof rows;

  return sorted.map((row) => ({
    checkpoint_id: row.checkpoint_id,
    branch: row.branch,
    prompt: row.prompt ?? null,
    agent: row.agent ?? "Claude Code",
    steps: row.steps ?? 1,
    session_count: row.session_count ?? 1,
    strategy: row.strategy ?? null,
    created_at: dateToStr(row.created_at),
    commit_sha: row.commit_sha,
    commit_message: row.commit_message,
    commit_author: row.commit_author,
    commit_author_username: row.commit_author_username,
    commit_date: dateToStr(row.commit_date),
    additions: row.additions ?? 0,
    deletions: row.deletions ?? 0,
    files_changed: row.files_changed ?? 0,
    files_touched: (row.files_touched as string[] | null) ?? [],
    file_stats: (row.file_stats as FileStats[] | null) ?? null,
    input_tokens: row.input_tokens ?? null,
    cache_creation_tokens: row.cache_creation_tokens ?? null,
    cache_read_tokens: row.cache_read_tokens ?? null,
    output_tokens: row.output_tokens ?? null,
    api_call_count: row.api_call_count ?? null,
    attribution_agent_lines: row.attribution_agent_lines ?? null,
    attribution_human_added: row.attribution_human_added ?? null,
    attribution_human_modified: row.attribution_human_modified ?? null,
    attribution_human_removed: row.attribution_human_removed ?? null,
    attribution_total_committed: row.attribution_total_committed ?? null,
    attribution_agent_percentage: row.attribution_agent_percentage ?? null,
    attribution_calculated_at: dateToStr(row.attribution_calculated_at),
  }));
}

export async function getRepoWithCheckpoints(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoFullName: string,
  userId: string,
  branch: string,
  limit: number = 100,
): Promise<RepoWithCheckpointsResult | null | "no_access"> {
  // Step 1: Get the repo with user access check
  const repoRow = await db
    .selectFrom("repos")
    .innerJoin("user_repos", (join) =>
      join
        .onRef("user_repos.repo_id", "=", "repos.id")
        .on("user_repos.user_id", "=", userId),
    )
    .selectAll("repos")
    .where("repos.full_name", "=", repoFullName)
    .executeTakeFirst();

  if (!repoRow) {
    // Distinguish between repo not found vs no access
    const repoOnly = await db
      .selectFrom("repos")
      .select("id")
      .where("full_name", "=", repoFullName)
      .executeTakeFirst();

    return repoOnly ? "no_access" : null;
  }

  // Convert repo row to Repo type (number→boolean, Date→string)
  const repo: Repo = {
    id: repoRow.id,
    github_id: repoRow.github_id,
    full_name: repoRow.full_name,
    name: repoRow.name,
    description: repoRow.description,
    html_url: repoRow.html_url,
    language: repoRow.language,
    stargazers_count: repoRow.stargazers_count,
    is_fork: toBool(repoRow.is_fork),
    is_private: toBool(repoRow.is_private),
    pushed_at: dateToStr(repoRow.pushed_at),
    default_branch: repoRow.default_branch,
    app_has_access: toBool(repoRow.app_has_access),
    checkpoints_backfilled_at: dateToStr(repoRow.checkpoints_backfilled_at),
    checkpoints_last_synced_at: dateToStr(repoRow.checkpoints_last_synced_at),
    checkpoints_sync_cursor: repoRow.checkpoints_sync_cursor,
    checkpoints_sync_error: repoRow.checkpoints_sync_error,
    checkpoints_sync_error_at: dateToStr(repoRow.checkpoints_sync_error_at),
    checkpoint_count: repoRow.checkpoint_count,
    installation_id: repoRow.installation_id,
    activity_weeks: repoRow.activity_weeks,
    activity_week_start: repoRow.activity_week_start,
    activity_synced_at: dateToStr(repoRow.activity_synced_at),
    created_at: repoRow.created_at.toISOString(),
    updated_at: repoRow.updated_at.toISOString(),
  };

  // Step 2: Get checkpoints for this branch
  const checkpoints = await getCheckpointsForBranch(db, repoRow.id, branch, { limit });

  return { repo, checkpoints };
}

export async function getBranchesWithCheckpoints(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
): Promise<Array<{ branch: string; checkpoint_count: number }>> {
  // Kysely GROUP BY
  const rows = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits")
    .select(["branch", db.fn.countAll<number>().as("checkpoint_count")])
    .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
    .groupBy("branch")
    .orderBy("checkpoint_count", "desc")
    .execute();

  return rows.map((row) => ({
    branch: row.branch,
    checkpoint_count: row.checkpoint_count,
  }));
}

export async function branchHasCheckpointCommits(

}

export async function findCheckpointById(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
  checkpointId: string,
  defaultBranch: string = "main",
): Promise<CheckpointLocation | null> {
  // Query 1: Get all commits for this checkpoint across all branches
  const commits = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits")
    .selectAll()
    .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
    .where("checkpoint_id", "=", checkpointId)
    .execute();

  if (commits.length === 0) return null;

  // Query 2: Get checkpoint metadata
  const checkpoint = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoints")
    .selectAll()
    .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
    .where("checkpoint_id", "=", checkpointId)
    .executeTakeFirst();

  // Get unique branches
  const branches = [...new Set(commits.map((c) => c.branch))];
  const onDefaultBranch = branches.includes(defaultBranch) ? defaultBranch : null;

  // Pick the best commit: prefer default branch, then source branch, then first
  let preferredCommit = commits.find((c) => c.branch === defaultBranch);
  if (!preferredCommit && checkpoint?.branch) {
    preferredCommit = commits.find((c) => c.branch === checkpoint.branch);
  }
  if (!preferredCommit) {
    preferredCommit = commits[0];
  }

  const commit: CheckpointWithCommit = {
    checkpoint_id: preferredCommit.checkpoint_id,
    branch: preferredCommit.branch,
    prompt: checkpoint?.prompt ?? null,
    agent: checkpoint?.agent ?? "Claude Code",
    steps: checkpoint?.steps ?? 1,
    session_count: checkpoint?.session_count ?? 1,
    strategy: checkpoint?.strategy ?? null,
    created_at: dateToStr(checkpoint?.created_at),
    commit_sha: preferredCommit.commit_sha,
    commit_message: preferredCommit.commit_message,
    commit_author: preferredCommit.commit_author,
    commit_author_username: preferredCommit.commit_author_username,
    commit_date: dateToStr(preferredCommit.commit_date),
    additions: preferredCommit.additions,
    deletions: preferredCommit.deletions,
    files_changed: preferredCommit.files_changed,
    files_touched: (checkpoint?.files_touched as string[] | null) ?? [],
    file_stats: (preferredCommit.file_stats as FileStats[] | null) ?? null,
    input_tokens: checkpoint?.input_tokens ?? null,
    cache_creation_tokens: checkpoint?.cache_creation_tokens ?? null,
    cache_read_tokens: checkpoint?.cache_read_tokens ?? null,
    output_tokens: checkpoint?.output_tokens ?? null,
    api_call_count: checkpoint?.api_call_count ?? null,
    attribution_agent_lines: checkpoint?.attribution_agent_lines ?? null,
    attribution_human_added: checkpoint?.attribution_human_added ?? null,
    attribution_human_modified: checkpoint?.attribution_human_modified ?? null,
    attribution_human_removed: checkpoint?.attribution_human_removed ?? null,
    attribution_total_committed: checkpoint?.attribution_total_committed ?? null,
    attribution_agent_percentage: checkpoint?.attribution_agent_percentage ?? null,
    attribution_calculated_at: dateToStr(checkpoint?.attribution_calculated_at),
  };

  return {
    checkpoint_id: checkpointId,
    branches,
    default_branch: onDefaultBranch,
    commit,
  };
}

export async function getCheckpointsByIds(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
  checkpointIds: string[],
): Promise<CheckpointWithCommit[]> {
  if (checkpointIds.length === 0) return [];

  // Deferred join: sort/limit on IDs only to avoid "Out of sort memory" on large JSON columns.
  const idRows = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits")
    .select(["id", "checkpoint_id"])
    .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
    .where("checkpoint_id", "in", checkpointIds)
    .orderBy("commit_date", "desc")
    .execute();

  if (idRows.length === 0) return [];

  // Deduplicate: keep first (newest) row per checkpoint_id
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const dedupedIds = idRows.filter((row) => {
    if (seen.has(row.checkpoint_id)) return false;
    seen.add(row.checkpoint_id);
    return true;
  });

  // Fetch full data for the deduplicated IDs (no ORDER BY to avoid sort buffer OOM)
  const commitRows = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits as cc")
    .leftJoin("repo_checkpoints as cp", (join) =>
      join
        .onRef("cp.repo_id", "=", "cc.repo_id")
        .onRef("cp.checkpoint_id", "=", "cc.checkpoint_id"),
    )
    .select([
      "cc.id",
      "cc.checkpoint_id",
      "cc.branch",
      "cc.commit_sha",
      "cc.commit_message",

export async function deleteCommitsByBranch(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
  branch: string,
): Promise<number> {
  const result = await db
    .deleteFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits")
    .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
    .where("branch", "=", branch)
    .executeTakeFirst();

  return Number(result.numDeletedRows);
}

// Delete stale commits for a branch that are not in the valid set of checkpoint IDs.
// Used during sync backfill to reconcile after force pushes or history rewrites.
export async function deleteStaleCommitsForBranch(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
  branch: string,
  validCheckpointIds: string[],
): Promise<number> {
  if (validCheckpointIds.length === 0) {
    // No valid checkpoints = delete all commits for this branch
    return deleteCommitsByBranch(db, repoId, branch);
  }

  const result = await db
    .deleteFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits")
    .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
    .where("branch", "=", branch)
    .where("checkpoint_id", "not in", validCheckpointIds)
    .executeTakeFirst();

  return Number(result.numDeletedRows);
}

export async function deleteOrphanedCheckpoints(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
): Promise<number> {
  // Get all checkpoint_ids that have commits
  const commitsData = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits")
    .select("checkpoint_id")
    .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
    .execute();

  const commitCheckpointIds = new Set(commitsData.map((c) => c.checkpoint_id));

  // Get all checkpoints for this repo
  const checkpointsData = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoints")
    .select(["id", "checkpoint_id", "created_at"])
    .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
    .execute();

  // Grace period: don't delete checkpoints created in the last 5 minutes
  const gracePeriodMs = 5 * 60 * 1000;
  const cutoffTime = Date.now() - gracePeriodMs;

  const orphanedIds = checkpointsData
    .filter((cp) => {
      if (commitCheckpointIds.has(cp.checkpoint_id)) return false;
      if (!cp.created_at) return true;
      return cp.created_at.getTime() < cutoffTime;
    })
    .map((cp) => cp.id);

  if (orphanedIds.length === 0) return 0;

  // Delete orphaned checkpoints in batches to avoid oversized IN lists.
  // Each batch re-checks via NOT IN subquery to avoid FK violations from race conditions.
  const BATCH_SIZE = 100;
  let totalDeleted = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < orphanedIds.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
    const batch = orphanedIds.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);
    const result = await db
      .deleteFrom("repo_checkpoints")
      .where("id", "in", batch)
      .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
      .where((eb) =>
        eb(
          "checkpoint_id",
          "not in",
          eb
            .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits")
            .select("checkpoint_id")
            .where("repo_id", "=", repoId),
        ),
      )
      .executeTakeFirst();

    totalDeleted += Number(result.numDeletedRows);
  }

  return totalDeleted;
}

export async function recalculateCheckpointCount(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
): Promise<void> {
  // Count distinct checkpoints that have commits
  const rows = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits")
    .select("checkpoint_id")
    .distinct()
    .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
    .execute();

  // CRITICAL: If query fails it will throw, which is safe (won't set to 0)
  await db
    .updateTable("repos")
    .set({
      checkpoint_count: rows.length,
      updated_at: new Date(),
    })
    .where("id", "=", repoId)
    .execute();
}

/**
 * Returns the week index (0-51) for a commit date relative to currentWeekStart.
 * Week 51 = current week, week 0 = 51 weeks ago. Returns null if outside the 52-week window.
 * Week boundaries align to Sunday 00:00:00.
 */
export function commitDateToWeekIndex(commitDate: Date, currentWeekStart: Date): number | null {
  const weeksAgo = Math.ceil(
    (currentWeekStart.getTime() - commitDate.getTime()) / (7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
  );

  if (weeksAgo >= 0 && weeksAgo < 52) {
    return 51 - weeksAgo;
  }
  return null;
}

export async function getCheckpointActivityForUser(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  userId: string,
): Promise<RepoCommitActivity[]> {
  const fiftyTwoWeeksAgo = new Date();
  fiftyTwoWeeksAgo.setDate(fiftyTwoWeeksAgo.getDate() - 52 * 7);

  const commits = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits as cc")
    .innerJoin("repos", "repos.id", "cc.repo_id")
    .innerJoin("user_repos", (join) =>
      join
        .onRef("user_repos.repo_id", "=", "repos.id")
        .on("user_repos.user_id", "=", userId),
    )
    .select([
      "cc.repo_id",
      "cc.checkpoint_id",
      "cc.commit_date",
      "repos.full_name",
    ])
    .where("repos.is_fork", "=", 0)
    .where("cc.commit_date", ">=", fiftyTwoWeeksAgo)
    .where("cc.commit_date", "is not", null)
    .execute();

  // Build repo map
  const repoMap = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const commit of commits) {
    if (commit.repo_id && !repoMap.has(commit.repo_id)) {
      repoMap.set(commit.repo_id, commit.full_name);
    }
  }

  // Calculate the start of the current week (Sunday)
  const now = new Date();
  const currentWeekStart = new Date(now);
  currentWeekStart.setDate(now.getDate() - now.getDay());
  currentWeekStart.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

  const oldestWeekStart = new Date(currentWeekStart);
  oldestWeekStart.setDate(oldestWeekStart.getDate() - 51 * 7);
  const weekStartTimestamp = Math.floor(oldestWeekStart.getTime() / 1000);

  // Aggregate commits by repo and week, deduplicating by checkpoint_id
  const repoWeeks = new Map<string, number[]>();
  const seenCheckpoints = new Map<string, Set<string>>();

  for (const commit of commits) {
    const repoFullName = repoMap.get(commit.repo_id ?? "");
    if (!repoFullName || !commit.commit_date) continue;

    const commitDate = commit.commit_date instanceof Date
      ? commit.commit_date
      : new Date(commit.commit_date);
    const weekIndex = commitDateToWeekIndex(commitDate, currentWeekStart);

    if (weekIndex !== null) {
      const dedupeKey = `${repoFullName}:${weekIndex}`;

      if (!seenCheckpoints.has(dedupeKey)) {
        seenCheckpoints.set(dedupeKey, new Set());
      }
      const seen = seenCheckpoints.get(dedupeKey)!;
      if (seen.has(commit.checkpoint_id)) continue;
      seen.add(commit.checkpoint_id);

      if (!repoWeeks.has(repoFullName)) {
        repoWeeks.set(repoFullName, new Array(52).fill(0));
      }
      repoWeeks.get(repoFullName)![weekIndex]++;
    }
  }

  const activities: RepoCommitActivity[] = [];
  for (const [repoFullName, weeks] of repoWeeks) {
    activities.push({ repo_full_name: repoFullName, weeks, week_start: weekStartTimestamp });
  }

  return activities;
}

export async function getCheckpointsByUser(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  userId: string,
  githubId: number,
  startDate: string,
  endDate: string,
  limit: number = 500,
): Promise<UserCheckpoint[]> {
  const commits = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits as cc")
    .innerJoin("repos", "repos.id", "cc.repo_id")
    .innerJoin("user_repos", (join) =>
      join
        .onRef("user_repos.repo_id", "=", "repos.id")
        .on("user_repos.user_id", "=", userId),
    )
    .leftJoin("repo_checkpoints as cp", (join) =>
      join
        .onRef("cp.repo_id", "=", "cc.repo_id")
        .onRef("cp.checkpoint_id", "=", "cc.checkpoint_id"),
    )
    .select([
      "cc.checkpoint_id",
      "cc.branch",
      "cc.commit_sha",
      "cc.commit_message",
      "cc.commit_date",
      "cc.additions",
      "cc.deletions",
      "cc.files_changed",
      "cc.repo_id",
      "repos.full_name as repo_full_name",
      "repos.is_private",
      "cp.agent",
      "cp.steps",
      "cp.session_count",
      "cp.input_tokens",
      "cp.output_tokens",
    ])
    .where("cc.commit_author_github_id", "=", githubId)
    .where("cc.commit_date", ">=", new Date(startDate))
    .where("cc.commit_date", "<=", new Date(endDate))
    .orderBy("cc.commit_date", "desc")
    .limit(limit * 2) // Fetch extra to account for duplicates
    .execute();

  if (commits.length === 0) return [];

  // Deduplicate by (repo_id, checkpoint_id), preferring main branch
  const deduplicatedCommits = new Map<string, (typeof commits)[0]>();

  for (const commit of commits) {
    const key = `${commit.repo_id}:${commit.checkpoint_id}`;
    const existing = deduplicatedCommits.get(key);

    if (!existing) {
      deduplicatedCommits.set(key, commit);
    } else if (commit.branch === "main" && existing.branch !== "main") {
      deduplicatedCommits.set(key, commit);
    }
  }

  return Array.from(deduplicatedCommits.values())
    .slice(0, limit)
    .map((commit) => ({
      checkpoint_id: commit.checkpoint_id,
      commit_sha: commit.commit_sha,
      commit_message: commit.commit_message,
      commit_date: dateToStr(commit.commit_date),
      additions: commit.additions ?? 0,
      deletions: commit.deletions ?? 0,
      files_changed: commit.files_changed ?? 0,
      repo_full_name: commit.repo_full_name ?? "",
      branch: commit.branch,
      is_private: toBool(commit.is_private),
      agent: commit.agent ?? null,
      steps: commit.steps ?? null,
      session_count: commit.session_count ?? null,
      input_tokens: commit.input_tokens ?? null,
      output_tokens: commit.output_tokens ?? null,
    }));
}

export async function upsertSyncCheckpointBatch(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
  checkpoints: CheckpointData[],
): Promise<number> {
  if (checkpoints.length === 0) return 0;

  const uniqueCheckpoints = deduplicateCheckpoints(checkpoints);
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  let successCount = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < uniqueCheckpoints.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
    const batch = uniqueCheckpoints.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);

    // Fetch existing records for COALESCE behavior
    let existingRecords;
    try {
      existingRecords = await db
        .selectFrom("repo_checkpoints")
        .selectAll()
        .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
        .where("checkpoint_id", "in", batch.map((cp) => cp.checkpoint_id))
        .execute();
    } catch (e) {
      syncLog("fetch_existing_checkpoints_error", { batch: i / BATCH_SIZE + 1, error: String(e) });
      continue;
    }

    const existingMap = new Map(existingRecords.map((row) => [row.checkpoint_id, row]));

    const safeJsonParse = (value: string | null | undefined, fallback: unknown): unknown => {
      if (!value) return fallback;
      try {
        return JSON.parse(value);
      } catch {
        syncLog("json_parse_error", { value: value.substring(0, 100) });

    for (const cp of batch) {
      const existing = existingMap.get(cp.checkpoint_id);
      const values = {
        id: existing?.id ?? generateId(),
        repo_id: repoId,
        checkpoint_id: cp.checkpoint_id,

        branch: cp.branch ?? existing?.branch ?? null,
        session_id: cp.session_id ?? existing?.session_id ?? null,
        files_touched: JSON.stringify(safeJsonParse(cp.files_touched, existing?.files_touched ?? null)) as unknown as string,
        session_ids: JSON.stringify(safeJsonParse(cp.session_ids, existing?.session_ids ?? null)) as unknown as string,
        transcript_uuid_at_start: cp.transcript_uuid_at_start ?? existing?.transcript_uuid_at_start ?? null,
        transcript_lines_at_start: cp.transcript_lines_at_start ?? existing?.transcript_lines_at_start ?? null,
        checkpoint_transcript_start:
          cp.checkpoint_transcript_start ??
          existing?.checkpoint_transcript_start ??
          cp.transcript_lines_at_start ??
          existing?.transcript_lines_at_start ??
          null,
        input_tokens: cp.input_tokens ?? existing?.input_tokens ?? null,
        cache_creation_tokens: cp.cache_creation_tokens ?? existing?.cache_creation_tokens ?? null,
        cache_read_tokens: cp.cache_read_tokens ?? existing?.cache_read_tokens ?? null,
        output_tokens: cp.output_tokens ?? existing?.output_tokens ?? null,
        api_call_count: cp.api_call_count ?? existing?.api_call_count ?? null,
        sessions: JSON.stringify(safeJsonParse(cp.sessions, existing?.sessions ?? null)) as unknown as string,
        created_at: cp.created_at ? new Date(cp.created_at) : existing?.created_at ?? new Date(now),
        synced_at: new Date(now),
      };

      try {
        await db
          .insertInto("repo_checkpoints")
          .values(values)
          .onDuplicateKeyUpdate({
            prompt: values.prompt,

export async function upsertSyncCommitBatch(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
  commits: CommitData[],
): Promise<number> {
  if (commits.length === 0) return 0;

  const uniqueCommits = deduplicateCommits(commits);
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  let successCount = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < uniqueCommits.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
    const batch = uniqueCommits.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);

    let existingRecords;
    try {
      existingRecords = await db
        .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits")
        .selectAll()
        .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
        .where("checkpoint_id", "in", batch.map((c) => c.checkpoint_id))
        .execute();
    } catch (e) {
      syncLog("fetch_existing_error", { batch: i / BATCH_SIZE + 1, error: String(e) });
      continue;
    }

    const existingMap = new Map(existingRecords.map((row) => [`${row.checkpoint_id}:${row.branch}`, row]));

    for (const c of batch) {
      const existing = existingMap.get(`${c.checkpoint_id}:${c.branch}`);
      const values = {
        id: existing?.id ?? generateId(),
        repo_id: repoId,
        checkpoint_id: c.checkpoint_id,
        branch: c.branch,
        commit_sha: c.commit_sha ?? existing?.commit_sha ?? null,
        commit_message: c.commit_message ?? existing?.commit_message ?? null,
        commit_author: c.commit_author ?? existing?.commit_author ?? null,
        commit_author_username: c.commit_author_username ?? existing?.commit_author_username ?? null,
        commit_author_github_id: c.commit_author_github_id ?? existing?.commit_author_github_id ?? null,
        commit_date: c.commit_date ? new Date(c.commit_date) : existing?.commit_date ?? null,
        additions: c.additions ?? existing?.additions ?? 0,
        deletions: c.deletions ?? existing?.deletions ?? 0,
        files_changed: c.files_changed ?? existing?.files_changed ?? 0,
        file_stats: JSON.stringify(c.file_stats ?? existing?.file_stats ?? null) as unknown as string,
        synced_at: new Date(now),
      };

      try {
        await db
          .insertInto("repo_checkpoint_commits")
          .values(values)
          .onDuplicateKeyUpdate({
            commit_sha: values.commit_sha,
            commit_message: values.commit_message,
            commit_author: values.commit_author,
            commit_author_username: values.commit_author_username,
            commit_author_github_id: values.commit_author_github_id,
            commit_date: values.commit_date,
            additions: values.additions,
            deletions: values.deletions,
            files_changed: values.files_changed,
            file_stats: values.file_stats,
            synced_at: values.synced_at,
          })
          .execute();
        successCount++;
      } catch (e) {
        syncLog("upsert_commit_error", { checkpoint_id: c.checkpoint_id, branch: c.branch, error: String(e) });
        continue;
      }
    }
  }

  return successCount;
}

export async function updateRepoSyncState(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
  options: {
    cursor?: string;
    backfilled?: boolean;
    resetBackfill?: boolean;
    error?: string;
  },
): Promise<void> {
  const now = new Date();

  if (options.error) {
    await db
      .updateTable("repos")
      .set({
        checkpoints_sync_error: options.error,
        checkpoints_sync_error_at: now,
        updated_at: now,
      })
      .where("id", "=", repoId)
      .execute();
    return;
  }

  const updates: Record<string, unknown> = {
    checkpoints_last_synced_at: now,
    checkpoints_sync_error: null,
    checkpoints_sync_error_at: null,
    updated_at: now,
  };

  if (options.cursor) {
    updates.checkpoints_sync_cursor = options.cursor;
  }

  if (options.backfilled) {
    updates.checkpoints_backfilled_at = now;
  }

  // Force a full re-backfill on the next sync (e.g., after force push)
  if (options.resetBackfill) {
    updates.checkpoints_backfilled_at = null;
    updates.checkpoints_sync_cursor = null;
  }

  await db
    .updateTable("repos")
    .set(updates)
    .where("id", "=", repoId)
    .execute();
}

// --- Transcript Functions ---

export async function getCheckpointTranscript(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
  checkpointId: string,
): Promise<{ transcript_stripped: string | null; sessions: string | null } | null> {
  const row = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoints")
    .select(["transcript_stripped", "sessions"])
    .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
    .where("checkpoint_id", "=", checkpointId)
    .executeTakeFirst();

  if (!row) return null;

  return {
    transcript_stripped: row.transcript_stripped ? JSON.stringify(row.transcript_stripped) : null,
    sessions: row.sessions ? JSON.stringify(row.sessions) : null,
  };
}

export async function updateTranscriptBatch(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
  updates: Array<{ checkpoint_id: string; transcript_stripped: string }>,
): Promise<number> {
  if (updates.length === 0) return 0;

  let updated = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < updates.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
    const batch = updates.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);
    for (const { checkpoint_id, transcript_stripped } of batch) {
      try {
        const result = await db
          .updateTable("repo_checkpoints")
          .set({ transcript_stripped: transcript_stripped as unknown as string })
          .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
          .where("checkpoint_id", "=", checkpoint_id)
          .execute();
        if (result[0] && Number(result[0].numUpdatedRows) > 0) {
          updated++;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.log(`${LOG_PREFIX} update_transcript_error`, JSON.stringify({
          checkpoint_id,
          error: String(e),
        }));
      }
    }
  }
  return updated;
}

# Review 01

> Status: pending-dev
> Date: 2026-03-05
> Reviewer: Code Review Agent
> Verdict: REQUEST CHANGES

## Previous Review Status

No previous reviews.

## New Findings

### Critical (Must Fix)

**[planetscale/checkpoints.ts:1199] Double-serialization of `transcript_stripped` in `getCheckpointTranscript`**

This is the most significant bug in the feature. When Kysely reads a JSON column from MySQL/PlanetScale, the ORM automatically deserializes the stored JSON string into a JavaScript value (an object/array). The code then calls `JSON.stringify()` on that already-parsed value to return a string. That is correct on its own.

However, the caller in `search-index-queue.ts` (line 122) then calls `JSON.parse()` on the result to get `Record<string, string>`. This round-trip works:

```
DB stores: '{"0":"...jsonl...","1":"...jsonl..."}'
Kysely reads: { "0": "...jsonl...", "1": "...jsonl..." }  (parsed object)
getCheckpointTranscript returns: '{"0":"...jsonl...","1":"...jsonl..."}'  (re-stringified)
search-index-queue.ts JSON.parse(): { "0": "...jsonl...", "1": "...jsonl..." }  (correct)
```

But in `cache.ts` (line 2630), the result is again `JSON.parse`d:

```typescript
const strippedSessions = JSON.parse(dbRow.transcript_stripped) as Record<string, string>;
```

This also works for the happy path. BUT: the `sessions` column in `getCheckpointTranscript` (line 1200) is handled identically — `JSON.stringify(row.sessions)`. In `cache.ts` at line 2642 this is then `JSON.parse`d again:

```typescript
const sessionsInfo = JSON.parse(dbRow.sessions) as Array<{ ... }>;
```

The issue is that the `sessions` column is already stored as a JSON string in MySQL (the upsert code at line 487 calls `JSON.stringify(cp.sessions)` before storing). When Kysely reads it back, it auto-parses the JSON column, giving back the original object. Then `getCheckpointTranscript` wraps it in `JSON.stringify` again — this is correct.

**However**: the concern is whether `transcript_stripped` will behave identically in `updateTranscriptBatch`. At line 1218, the update is:

```typescript
.set({ transcript_stripped: transcript_stripped as unknown as string })
```

The `transcript_stripped` argument is already a JSON string (from `JSON.stringify(sessions)` in the queue). Kysely will pass this string value to MySQL, which will store it. When MySQL/PlanetScale stores a value in a `JSON` column, it validates and re-stores it. If the value passed is already a JSON string (e.g., `'{"0":"..."})'`), MySQL stores it as-is (a JSON object). Kysely will then read it back as the parsed object.

This means `getCheckpointTranscript` correctly re-serializes it. The round-trip is:

```
queue sends: JSON.stringify({ "0": "stripped-jsonl" })  → '{"0":"stripped-jsonl"}'
updateTranscriptBatch stores: '{"0":"stripped-jsonl"}'  (MySQL sees valid JSON object)
Kysely reads back: { "0": "stripped-jsonl" }  (auto-parsed)
getCheckpointTranscript returns: '{"0":"stripped-jsonl"}'  (JSON.stringify)
callers JSON.parse: { "0": "stripped-jsonl" }  (correct)
```

This does work, but it is fragile and confusing. The `as unknown as string` type cast at line 1218 masks a subtle correctness question: is the MySQL driver treating the string as a pre-serialized JSON value, or will it try to double-serialize it? In PlanetScale (MySQL), setting a JSON column to a string value causes MySQL to parse and store the JSON — if the string is valid JSON this is fine. Confirm this assumption holds by adding a test or comment explaining the round-trip. Without a test, the next developer will be confused and may break it.

**Suggested fix**: Add a comment in `updateTranscriptBatch` explaining the serialization contract, and add at minimum one integration test or explicit comment in `getCheckpointTranscript` explaining why the JSON column value is re-stringified before return.

---

**[planetscale/checkpoints.ts:1218] `updateTranscriptBatch` stores row-by-row in a loop — N individual UPDATE queries**

The current implementation issues one UPDATE per checkpoint, per batch of 50:

```typescript
for (const { checkpoint_id, transcript_stripped } of batch) {
  await db.updateTable("repo_checkpoints").set(...).where(...).execute();
}
```

For the search-index-queue processing up to `TRANSCRIPT_CONCURRENCY = 10` checkpoints at once, this is 10 sequential UPDATE queries. It works but is inefficient. MySQL/PlanetScale supports bulk updates via `INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE` or using a `CASE` expression. Given the existing `BATCH_SIZE = 50` constant and the established pattern of `onDuplicateKeyUpdate` elsewhere in this file, consider a batch UPDATE to reduce round-trips. This is not blocking for launch but becomes a problem at scale.

---

**[cache.ts:2629-2714] DB path silently falls through to GitHub on empty `dbParsedSessions` even when `transcript_stripped` is present**

Consider this scenario: the DB has `transcript_stripped` populated but `sessions` metadata is missing or invalid JSON (parse failure at line 2669 means `dbSessionsMeta` stays empty). The code then falls through to parse transcripts using the empty meta array — `meta` will be `undefined` for every session index, so `agent` defaults to "Claude Code" and `transcriptIdentifierAtStart` is null. This leads to correct behavior for Claude Code but silently uses wrong defaults for other agents.

More importantly, the `catch` block at line 2716 catches ALL errors from the entire try block — including errors from `getParserForAgent`, `filterRelevantMessages`, or future code additions. An error in parsing would silently drop the DB-sourced transcript and cause an unnecessary GitHub fetch. The catch should be limited to the DB lookup itself, not the parsing logic.

**Suggested fix**: Restructure so the `try/catch` wraps only the `db.checkpoints.getTranscript()` call. Parsing errors should propagate or be logged explicitly so they are not swallowed.

---

### Important (Should Fix)

**[search-index-queue.ts:118-129] Sequential DB lookups for transcript existence — one query per checkpoint**

```typescript
for (const cp of checkpoints) {
  const row = await db.checkpoints.getTranscript(repoId, cp.checkpoint_id);
  ...
}
```

Each `getTranscript` call issues a separate `SELECT` query. For a batch of 10 checkpoints this is 10 sequential SELECT queries. The existing `getByIds` function already demonstrates how to do bulk lookups. This should be a single query fetching all rows by checkpoint ID. This is especially impactful since the search index queue is the hot path for post-sync processing.

**Suggested fix**: Add a `getTranscriptBatch(repoId: string, checkpointIds: string[])` method to `CheckpointsNamespace` and implement it with a single `WHERE checkpoint_id IN (...)` query.

---

**[repo-sync-service.ts:338] `discoveredCheckpointIds` returns ALL checkpoints discovered — not just new ones**

```typescript
return {
  status: "ok",
  checkpointsDiscovered: checkpointIds.length,
  checkpointsWithCommits: commitsFound,
  isBackfill,
  discoveredCheckpointIds: checkpointIds,
};
```

`checkpointIds` is the full set of checkpoints found on the branch (potentially thousands on a full backfill). On a first-time backfill of a large repo, this sends thousands of checkpoint IDs to `SEARCH_INDEX_QUEUE`. These are batched in groups of 50, but checkpoints that already have `transcript_stripped` in the DB from a previous run will waste queue messages (they pass through `ensureTranscriptsStored` and hit the DB lookup only to be a no-op for indexing).

For incremental syncs this is correct since `since` limits discovery to new commits. But for backfills (isBackfill=true), this queues every checkpoint ever discovered. If a repo has 1,000 checkpoints, this creates 20 queue messages even if they are all already indexed.

The field name `discoveredCheckpointIds` implies "newly discovered" but it is actually "all discovered." Either rename it to `allDiscoveredCheckpointIds` and document the intent, or filter to only truly new checkpoints (those that weren't already in the DB before this sync run).

---

**[search-index-queue.ts:141-145] Only session `"0"` is used for search indexing — other sessions silently ignored**

```typescript
const primaryJsonl = sessions["0"];
if (primaryJsonl) {
  transcripts.set(cp.checkpoint_id, parseTranscriptExcerpt(primaryJsonl, cp.agent));
}
```

This comment says "Use session 0 for search indexing (primary session)" but there is no fallback if session 0 is absent. For checkpoints where session 0's transcript was empty or failed to fetch (e.g., the `fetchFileAtCommit` for `0/full.jsonl` returned nothing), the map entry is never set. The caller then gets `null` for the transcript. This is acceptable behavior but should be explicitly documented. Also, multi-session checkpoints only index the first session's content, meaning later turns in the same checkpoint are not searchable.

---

**[cache.ts:2630] `JSON.parse` on `dbRow.transcript_stripped` is not guarded against non-object values**

```typescript
const strippedSessions = JSON.parse(dbRow.transcript_stripped) as Record<string, string>;
```

If `transcript_stripped` somehow contains a JSON-encoded primitive (`"null"`, `"42"`, `"true"`), `JSON.parse` succeeds but the result is not a `Record<string, string>`. The `Object.keys(strippedSessions)` call at line 2675 would return an empty array for a non-object, silently falling through to GitHub. This is acceptable degradation but could confuse debugging — add a type check after parsing:

```typescript
if (typeof strippedSessions !== "object" || strippedSessions === null || Array.isArray(strippedSessions)) {
  throw new Error("unexpected transcript_stripped shape");
}
```

---

**[repo-sync-queue.ts:280-291] Missing `env.SEARCH_INDEX_QUEUE` type safety / silent skip when queue is absent**

```typescript
if (cpIds && cpIds.length > 0 && env.SEARCH_INDEX_QUEUE) {
```

When `SEARCH_INDEX_QUEUE` is not bound (e.g., local dev without queue binding), the transcript storage step is silently skipped. This is intentional, but there is no log message to indicate that indexing was skipped due to missing queue binding. Add a log line for observability:

```typescript
if (!env.SEARCH_INDEX_QUEUE) {
  log("search_index_queue_not_bound", { repoId, checkpointCount: cpIds.length });
}
```

---

### Suggestions (Consider)

**[strip-transcript.ts] No guard against extremely large content blocks in `tool_use.input`**

The `stripAssistantContent` function keeps `b.input` for `tool_use` blocks verbatim. For tool calls like `Write` with very large file content in `input`, this can still be substantial. Consider adding a note or a size cap on `input` if transcript storage size becomes a concern.

**[strip-transcript.test.ts] Missing test for unknown entry types**

The fallback branch in `stripEntry` for unknown `type` values (non-assistant, non-user, non-dropped) is exercised by the multi-line test indirectly but there is no explicit test for an entry like `{ type: "result", ... }` being passed through with only `type/timestamp/message/uuid/requestId`. A dedicated test would prevent regressions if the fallback logic changes.

**[strip-transcript.test.ts] No test for `null` content in assistant message**

```typescript
message: { id: "m1", content: null }
```

`stripAssistantContent(null)` falls through to the final `return content` which returns `null`. This is correct but untested.

**[search-index-queue.ts:52-69] `fetchAndStripTranscript` silently swallows all errors**

The outer `catch` returns `null` for any fetch failure without logging. Since this is called for checkpoints missing from DB, a systematic GitHub fetch failure (e.g., installation token expired) would silently produce no transcripts for an entire batch. Add a log with the error before returning null.

**[004_add_transcript_stripped.ts] Migration has no `NOT NULL` constraint or index**

The column is nullable (`JSON NULL`), which is correct for a new column on an existing table. Consider whether a partial index on `(repo_id, checkpoint_id)` WHERE `transcript_stripped IS NULL` would help efficiently find checkpoints that still need transcript storage. This depends on query patterns.

**[cache.ts:2639-2672] `dbSessionsMeta` is built from `dbRow.sessions` but `dbRow` comes from `getCheckpointTranscript` which only selects `transcript_stripped` and `sessions`**

The `sessions` column in `db-types.ts` interface returns `string | null`, which is the re-serialized JSON. If the sessions column was stored with additional nested structure or the schema evolves, this coupling between the transcript endpoint and the sessions column format is fragile. Consider extracting the session metadata parsing into a shared helper that both the transcript endpoint and any future consumers can use.

---

### Praise

- The two-phase DB-first → GitHub-fallback pattern in `ensureTranscriptsStored` is clean and follows the existing codebase's defensive patterns well.
- `stripTranscript` is nicely isolated with a clear contract. The test coverage is solid — 15 focused unit tests with realistic multi-turn scenarios.
- The concurrency-limited GitHub fetching (`TRANSCRIPT_CONCURRENCY = 10`) with `Promise.all` per batch is the right approach.
- `discoveredCheckpointIds` being added to `RepoSyncResult` and threaded through to the queue in `repo-sync-queue.ts` is a clean integration that avoids a second DB lookup to find newly synced checkpoint IDs.
- Batching the `SEARCH_INDEX_QUEUE` sends in groups of 50 (`SEARCH_BATCH_SIZE`) is good defensive hygiene for queue message size limits.
- The `updateTranscriptBatch` function isolates errors per-checkpoint and continues the batch rather than failing the whole update on one bad row. Good resilience pattern.

---

## Summary

**Overall assessment: REQUEST CHANGES**

The feature is architecturally sound — the DB-first caching approach is correct and the `stripTranscript` implementation is well-tested. However there are two issues that require attention before this is production-safe:

1. **The JSON double-serialization in `getCheckpointTranscript`** is correct as written but is fragile and undocumented. It relies on MySQL treating the stored string as JSON rather than escaping it as a string literal. This needs a clarifying comment at minimum, and ideally a test exercising the full write → read round-trip.

2. **The broad `try/catch` in `cache.ts`** swallows parsing errors from the DB path, silently falling back to GitHub. This masks bugs and makes the DB path appear to work even when the parsing is broken.

The sequential DB lookups per checkpoint and the "all discovered" vs "newly discovered" checkpoint IDs are important performance and correctness issues that should be addressed before the feature runs at scale.

**Estimated effort to address feedback:** 2-4 hours for the critical/important items. The suggestions are optional.

## Review Summary — "Store Stripped Transcripts in MySQL"

**Verdict: REQUEST CHANGES**

### Critical (Must Fix)

**1. `getCheckpointTranscript` — JSON serialization is correct but fragile and undocumented**

In `/Users/evisdrenova/code/entire/devenv/entire.io/api/src/lib/planetscale/checkpoints.ts` at line 1199:

```typescript
transcript_stripped: row.transcript_stripped ? JSON.stringify(row.transcript_stripped) : null,
```

Kysely auto-parses the JSON column on read. The code then re-stringifies it, which callers (`search-index-queue.ts:122` and `cache.ts:2630`) then `JSON.parse` again. The round-trip works, but only because MySQL treats the input in `updateTranscriptBatch` as a JSON object literal, not an escaped string. This is undocumented and the `as unknown as string` cast at line 1218 masks the implicit contract. A comment explaining the serialization contract is needed at minimum.

**2. `cache.ts:2716` — broad `try/catch` swallows parsing errors, silently falls through to GitHub**

The entire DB-first block (lines 2627–2714) is wrapped in a single `try/catch`. Any error in `getParserForAgent`, `filterRelevantMessages`, or future code is silently treated as a DB failure, triggering an unnecessary GitHub fetch. The catch should only wrap the `db.checkpoints.getTranscript()` call itself.

---

### Important (Should Fix)

**3. `search-index-queue.ts:118` — Sequential DB lookups, one query per checkpoint.** Should be a single bulk SELECT `WHERE checkpoint_id IN (...)`.

**4. `repo-sync-service.ts:338` — `discoveredCheckpointIds` returns ALL checkpoints, not just new ones.** On a full backfill of a large repo this queues thousands of IDs including already-indexed checkpoints.

**5. `cache.ts:2630` — No type guard after `JSON.parse` on `transcript_stripped`.** A non-object parse result silently passes `Object.keys()` and falls through to GitHub with no indication of the bad data shape.

**6. `repo-sync-queue.ts:281` — No log when `SEARCH_INDEX_QUEUE` is absent.** Makes local dev debugging harder.

---

### What was done well

- `stripTranscript` is well-isolated with solid test coverage (15 unit tests, realistic multi-turn scenarios).
- The DB-first → GitHub-fallback pattern in `ensureTranscriptsStored` is clean and defensive.
- Concurrency-limited GitHub fetching and per-checkpoint error isolation in `updateTranscriptBatch` are the right patterns.
- Threading `discoveredCheckpointIds` through `RepoSyncResult` avoids a second DB lookup in the queue.
Good review. Let me address the key findings.

// Kysely database helpers for checkpoint operations (MySQL/PlanetScale)

import type { Kysely } from "kysely";
import type { DB, Json } from "../../../db/types";
import { deduplicateCheckpoints, deduplicateCommits } from "../db/sync-types";
import { generateId } from "../uuid";
import type { CheckpointData, CommitData } from "../db/sync-types";
import type {
  FileStats,
  CheckpointWithCommit,
  RepoWithCheckpointsResult,
  CheckpointLocation,
  CheckpointWebhookData,
  CommitWebhookData,
  UserCheckpoint,
  RepoCommitActivity,
} from "../db/checkpoints";
import type { CheckpointsNamespace } from "../db/db-types";
import type { Repo } from "../db/repos";
import { dateToStr, toBool } from "./row-helpers";

const LOG_PREFIX = "[db-checkpoints]";
const BATCH_SIZE = 50;

// --- Checkpoint Functions ---

export async function getCheckpointsForBranch(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
  branch: string,
  options: { limit?: number } = {},
): Promise<CheckpointWithCommit[]> {
  const { limit = 100 } = options;

  // Deferred join: sort/limit on IDs only to avoid "Out of sort memory" on large JSON columns.
  // PlanetScale's sort buffer can't hold file_stats blobs for many rows during ORDER BY.
  const idRows = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits")
    .select("id")
    .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
    .where("branch", "=", branch)
    .orderBy("commit_date", "desc")
    .limit(limit)
    .execute();

  if (idRows.length === 0) return [];

  const rows = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits as cc")
    .leftJoin("repo_checkpoints as cp", (join) =>
      join
        .onRef("cp.repo_id", "=", "cc.repo_id")
        .onRef("cp.checkpoint_id", "=", "cc.checkpoint_id"),
    )
    .select([
      "cc.id",
      "cc.checkpoint_id",
      "cc.branch",
      "cc.commit_sha",
      "cc.commit_message",
      "cc.commit_author",
      "cc.commit_author_username",
      "cc.commit_date",
      "cc.additions",
      "cc.deletions",
      "cc.files_changed",
      "cc.file_stats",
      "cp.prompt",
      "cp.agent",
      "cp.steps",
      "cp.session_count",
      "cp.strategy",
      "cp.created_at",
      "cp.files_touched",
      "cp.input_tokens",
      "cp.cache_creation_tokens",
      "cp.cache_read_tokens",
      "cp.output_tokens",
      "cp.api_call_count",
      "cp.attribution_agent_lines",
      "cp.attribution_human_added",
      "cp.attribution_human_modified",
      "cp.attribution_human_removed",
      "cp.attribution_total_committed",
      "cp.attribution_agent_percentage",
      "cp.attribution_calculated_at",
    ])
    .where(
      "cc.id",
      "in",
      idRows.map((r) => r.id),
    )
    .execute();

  // Restore sort order from the first query (already sorted by commit_date desc)
  // without ORDER BY on the large-row query which causes OOM on the sort buffer.
  const rowById = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.id, r]));
  const sorted = idRows.map((r) => rowById.get(r.id)).filter(Boolean) as typeof rows;

  return sorted.map((row) => ({
    checkpoint_id: row.checkpoint_id,
    branch: row.branch,
    prompt: row.prompt ?? null,
    agent: row.agent ?? "Claude Code",
    steps: row.steps ?? 1,
    session_count: row.session_count ?? 1,
    strategy: row.strategy ?? null,
    created_at: dateToStr(row.created_at),
    commit_sha: row.commit_sha,
    commit_message: row.commit_message,
    commit_author: row.commit_author,
    commit_author_username: row.commit_author_username,
    commit_date: dateToStr(row.commit_date),
    additions: row.additions ?? 0,
    deletions: row.deletions ?? 0,
    files_changed: row.files_changed ?? 0,
    files_touched: (row.files_touched as string[] | null) ?? [],
    file_stats: (row.file_stats as FileStats[] | null) ?? null,
    input_tokens: row.input_tokens ?? null,
    cache_creation_tokens: row.cache_creation_tokens ?? null,
    cache_read_tokens: row.cache_read_tokens ?? null,
    output_tokens: row.output_tokens ?? null,
    api_call_count: row.api_call_count ?? null,
    attribution_agent_lines: row.attribution_agent_lines ?? null,
    attribution_human_added: row.attribution_human_added ?? null,
    attribution_human_modified: row.attribution_human_modified ?? null,
    attribution_human_removed: row.attribution_human_removed ?? null,
    attribution_total_committed: row.attribution_total_committed ?? null,
    attribution_agent_percentage: row.attribution_agent_percentage ?? null,
    attribution_calculated_at: dateToStr(row.attribution_calculated_at),
  }));
}

export async function getRepoWithCheckpoints(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoFullName: string,
  userId: string,
  branch: string,
  limit: number = 100,
): Promise<RepoWithCheckpointsResult | null | "no_access"> {
  // Step 1: Get the repo with user access check
  const repoRow = await db
    .selectFrom("repos")
    .innerJoin("user_repos", (join) =>
      join
        .onRef("user_repos.repo_id", "=", "repos.id")
        .on("user_repos.user_id", "=", userId),
    )
    .selectAll("repos")
    .where("repos.full_name", "=", repoFullName)
    .executeTakeFirst();

  if (!repoRow) {
    // Distinguish between repo not found vs no access
    const repoOnly = await db
      .selectFrom("repos")
      .select("id")
      .where("full_name", "=", repoFullName)
      .executeTakeFirst();

    return repoOnly ? "no_access" : null;
  }

  // Convert repo row to Repo type (number→boolean, Date→string)
  const repo: Repo = {
    id: repoRow.id,
    github_id: repoRow.github_id,
    full_name: repoRow.full_name,
    name: repoRow.name,
    description: repoRow.description,
    html_url: repoRow.html_url,
    language: repoRow.language,
    stargazers_count: repoRow.stargazers_count,
    is_fork: toBool(repoRow.is_fork),
    is_private: toBool(repoRow.is_private),
    pushed_at: dateToStr(repoRow.pushed_at),
    default_branch: repoRow.default_branch,
    app_has_access: toBool(repoRow.app_has_access),
    checkpoints_backfilled_at: dateToStr(repoRow.checkpoints_backfilled_at),
    checkpoints_last_synced_at: dateToStr(repoRow.checkpoints_last_synced_at),
    checkpoints_sync_cursor: repoRow.checkpoints_sync_cursor,
    checkpoints_sync_error: repoRow.checkpoints_sync_error,
    checkpoints_sync_error_at: dateToStr(repoRow.checkpoints_sync_error_at),
    checkpoint_count: repoRow.checkpoint_count,
    installation_id: repoRow.installation_id,
    activity_weeks: repoRow.activity_weeks,
    activity_week_start: repoRow.activity_week_start,
    activity_synced_at: dateToStr(repoRow.activity_synced_at),
    created_at: repoRow.created_at.toISOString(),
    updated_at: repoRow.updated_at.toISOString(),
  };

  // Step 2: Get checkpoints for this branch
  const checkpoints = await getCheckpointsForBranch(db, repoRow.id, branch, { limit });

  return { repo, checkpoints };
}

export async function getBranchesWithCheckpoints(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
): Promise<Array<{ branch: string; checkpoint_count: number }>> {
  // Kysely GROUP BY
  const rows = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits")
    .select(["branch", db.fn.countAll<number>().as("checkpoint_count")])
    .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
    .groupBy("branch")
    .orderBy("checkpoint_count", "desc")
    .execute();

  return rows.map((row) => ({
    branch: row.branch,
    checkpoint_count: row.checkpoint_count,
  }));
}

export async function branchHasCheckpointCommits(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
  branch: string,
): Promise<boolean> {
  const row = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits")
    .select("id")
    .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
    .where("branch", "=", branch)
    .limit(1)
    .executeTakeFirst();

  return !!row;
}

export async function findCheckpointById(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
  checkpointId: string,
  defaultBranch: string = "main",
): Promise<CheckpointLocation | null> {
  // Query 1: Get all commits for this checkpoint across all branches
  const commits = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoint_commits")
    .selectAll()
    .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
    .where("checkpoint_id", "=", checkpointId)
    .execute();

  if (commits.length === 0) return null;

  // Query 2: Get checkpoint metadata
  const checkpoint = await db
    .selectFrom("repo_checkpoints")
    .selectAll()
    .where("repo_id", "=", repoId)
    .where("checkpoint_id", "=", checkpointId)
    .executeTakeFirst();

  // Get unique branches
  const branches = [...new Set(commits.map((c) => c.branch))];
  const onDefaultBranch = branches.includes(defaultBranch) ? defaultBranch : null;

  // Pick the best commit: prefer default branch, then source branch, then first
  let preferredCommit = commits.find((c) => c.branch === defaultBranch);
  if (!preferredCommit && checkpoint?.branch) {
    preferredCommit = commits.find((c) => c.branch === checkpoint.branch);
  }
  if (!preferredCommit) {
    preferredCommit = commits[0];
  }

  const commit: CheckpointWithCommit = {
    checkpoint_id: preferredCommit.checkpoint_id,
    branch: preferredCommit.branch,
    prompt: checkpoint?.prompt ?? null,
    agent: checkpoint?.agent ?? "Claude Code",
    steps: checkpoint?.steps ?? 1,
    session_count: checkpoint?.session_count ?? 1,
    strategy: checkpoint?.strategy ?? null,
    created_at: dateToStr(checkpoint?.created_at),
    commit_sha: preferredCommit.commit_sha,
    commit_message: preferredCommit.commit_message,
    commit_author: preferredCommit.commit_author,
    commit_author_username: preferredCommit.commit_author_username,
    commit_date: dateToStr(preferredCommit.commit_date),
    additions: preferredCommit.additions,
    deletions: preferredCommit.deletions,
    files_changed: preferredCommit.files_changed,
    files_touched: (checkpoint?.files_touched as string[] | null) ?? [],
    file_stats: (preferredCommit.file_stats as FileStats[] | null) ?? null,
    input_tokens: checkpoint?.input_tokens ?? null,
    cache_creation_tokens: checkpoint?.cache_creation_tokens ?? null,
    cache_read_tokens: checkpoint?.cache_read_tokens ?? null,
    output_tokens: checkpoint?.output_tokens ?? null,
    api_call_count: checkpoint?.api_call_count ?? null,
    attribution_agent_lines: checkpoint?.attribution_agent_lines ?? null,
    attribution_human_added: checkpoint?.attribution_human_added ?? null,
    attribution_human_modified: checkpoint?.attribution_human_modified ?? null,
    attribution_human_removed: checkpoint?.attribution_human_removed ?? null,
    attribution_total_committed: checkpoint?.attribution_total_committed ?? null,
    attribution_agent_percentage: checkpoint?.attribution_agent_percentage ?? null,
    attribution_calculated_at: dateToStr(checkpoint?.attribution_calculated_at),
  };

  return {
    checkpoint_id: checkpointId,
    branches,
    default_branch: onDefaultBranch,
    commit,
  };
}

export async function getCheckpointsByIds(
  db: Kysely<DB>,
  repoId: string,
  checkpointIds: string[],
): Promise<CheckpointWithCommit[]> {
  if (checkpointIds.length === 0) return [];

  // Deferred join: sort/limit on IDs only to avoid "Out of sort memory" on large JSON columns.

    .select([
      "cc.id",

  // Restore input checkpointIds order (trail detail expects checkpoints.json order)

    additions: row.additions ?? 0,
    deletions: row.deletions ?? 0,

    files_touched: (row.files_touched as string[] | null) ?? [],
